# AstroLabs & Co.

> AstroLabs & Co. is a UK-based web design studio building fast, accessible, custom websites for local small businesses, with transparent pricing, free hosting forever, and dedicated support.

AstroLabs & Co. (also written AstroLabs, AstroLabs and Co, AstroLabs & Co) designs and builds bespoke websites for UK small businesses from Maidstone, Kent. Services include custom web design, managed hosting, accessibility-first builds, and ongoing support. Plans start at £299. Contact: hello@astrolabs.uk. Website: https://www.astrolabs.uk

## Disambiguation

AstroLabs & Co. is an independent UK web design studio. It is not the Dubai-based AstroLabs business-expansion consultancy, and it is not Astro Labs the cannabis cultivator.

- Location: Maidstone, Kent, United Kingdom

- Included: Free hosting forever with every website
